name: IGEX Collaboration
notes: No roster or member count was found; the Atlas records no memberships.
The IGEX neutrinoless double-beta decay experiment is excluded from the Atlas dark matter coverage (primarily 0vbb); the status and dates here follow the dark matter activity only.

summary.plain: The international team of the International Germanium Experiment, built to look for a rare nuclear decay with enriched germanium crystals in the Canfranc underground laboratory; part of its detectors also searched for dark matter.
summary.technical: IGEX Collaboration: University of Zaragoza, University of South Carolina, Pacific Northwest National Laboratory, ITEP Moscow, INR Baksan Neutrino Observatory and Yerevan Physical Institute (author lists of the dark matter papers). Its main experiment, IGEX-2beta (76Ge neutrinoless double-beta decay), is not recorded in the Atlas; this record covers the dark matter search IGEX-DM.
